finding.text: The live proof skips the chat tail: `ux/Dictate/test/swallow.mjs:42-55` calls `w.say({summary})` on a bare Widget, so the `chat.js:170` routing line (the "existing live tail" in ask 3) is never exercised. The line is a one-liner that matches its `place` neighbour, so the risk is low, but a fixture line appended to a session file would prove ask 3 as it was worded.

The fake-mic step in the proof is weak. Every shot (`shots/swallow-folded-1200.png`, `swallow-open-400.png`) shows "nothing loud enough to transcribe was heard" under the mic, and the three card sentences are injected, not dictated. Ask 3 asked for three dictated sentences placed into one card.

`fold()` (`Widget.js`, the `n < 2` check) counts every line in the card, not only the raw ones, while ask 2 says "two or more raw lines". The behaviour is reasonable, because placed lines are never raw by then, but the doc should name the difference.

`draw_refined()` settles only `entry.re` (`Widget.js`, `this.settled.add(entry.re)`). A `{refined}` line covers every sentence in its `of` list, so the other sentences in that bubble keep the raw look.

`Widget.css:251`: `.ux-dictate-swallowed > [data-re]` gives every line in an unfolded card the raw look, placed lines included (`shots/swallow-open-400.png`). That fits "a click shows the raw words", but it reuses the raw style for lines that are not raw.
As the doc already says, a raw line that arrives after a summary is hidden in the fold until the next summary arrives. The "N raw lines" count does go up, so nothing is lost silently.
